source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseLeadConvertAccessorsTest { @isTest static void accessorsRoundTripValues() { Database.LeadConvert convert = new Database.LeadConvert(); Id accountId = '001000000000001AAA'; Id contactId = '003000000000001AAA'; Id leadId = '00Q000000000001AAA'; Id opportunityId = '006000000000001AAA'; Id ownerId = '005000000000001AAA'; Id personAccountId = '001000000000002AAA'; Account account = new Account(Name = 'Existing Account'); Contact contact = new Contact(LastName = 'Existing Contact'); Opportunity opportunity = new Opportunity(Name = 'Existing Opportunity', StageName = 'Prospecting', CloseDate = Date.today()); Account personAccount = new Account(Name = 'Existing Person'); convert.setAccountId(accountId); convert.setAccountRecord(account); convert.setBypassAccountDedupeCheck(true); convert.setBypassContactDedupeCheck(true); convert.setContactId(contactId); convert.setContactRecord(contact); convert.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); convert.setLeadId(leadId); convert.setOpportunityId(opportunityId); convert.setOpportunityName('Existing Opportunity'); convert.setOpportunityRecord(opportunity); convert.setOwnerId(ownerId); convert.setRelatedPersonAccountId(personAccountId); convert.setRelatedPersonAccountRecord(personAccount); convert.setDoNotCreateOpportunity(true); convert.setOverwriteLeadSource(true); convert.setSendNotificationEmail(true); System.assertEquals(accountId, convert.getAccountId()); System.assert(convert.getAccountRecord() != null); System.assertEquals(true, convert.getBypassAccountDedupeCheck()); System.assertEquals(true, convert.getBypassContactDedupeCheck()); System.assertEquals(contactId, convert.getContactId()); System.assert(convert.getContactRecord() != null); System.assertEquals('Qualified', convert.getConvertedStatus()); System.assertEquals(leadId, convert.getLeadID()); System.assertEquals(opportunityId, convert.getOpportunityId()); System.assertEquals('Existing Opportunity', convert.getOpportunityName()); System.assert(convert.getOpportunityRecord() != null); System.assertEquals(ownerId, convert.getOwnerID()); System.assertEquals(personAccountId, convert.getRelatedPersonAccountId()); System.assert(convert.getRelatedPersonAccountRecord() != null); System.assertEquals(true, convert.isDoNotCreateOpportunity()); System.assertEquals(true, convert.isOverWriteLeadSource()); System.assertEquals(true, convert.isSendNotificationEmail()); } }
